Given closed intervals [start,end] with start <= end, merge overlapping or endpoint-touching intervals. Return intervals sorted by start.

Call solve with the positional arguments shown in each test. Return the result; do not print.

Example

{
  "args": [
    [
      [
        5,
        8
      ],
      [
        1,
        3
      ],
      [
        3,
        6
      ],
      [
        10,
        11
      ]
    ]
  ],
  "expected": [
    [
      1,
      8
    ],
    [
      10,
      11
    ]
  ]
}

Example

{
  "args": [
    []
  ],
  "expected": []
}
Hint

Sort starts, then extend the current merged endpoint.

Complexity: O(n log n) time, O(n) space
